# Tasks: Feature-Scoped Working Memory

## Review Workload Forecast

Decision needed before apply: No
Chained PRs recommended: Yes
Chain strategy: feature-branch-chain
400-line budget risk: High

Epic total ~700–850 lines. Per-slice: S0~130 (Low), S1~110 (Low), S2~290 (Medium), S3~100 (Low), S4~90 (Low). No individual slice exceeds 400 lines.

### Chained PR plan

| Branch | Base |
|--------|------|
| `epic/working-memory` (tracker) | `main` |
| `feat/s0-working-memory-foundation` | `epic/working-memory` |
| `feat/s1-working-memory-contract` | `feat/s0-working-memory-foundation` |
| `feat/s2-working-memory-engram-impl` | `feat/s1-working-memory-contract` |
| `feat/s3-working-memory-ux` | `feat/s2-working-memory-engram-impl` |
| `feat/s4-working-memory-checkpoint-auto` | `feat/s3-working-memory-ux` |

Only tracker merges to main.

## Slice 0 — Foundation [REQ-S0-1, REQ-S0-2] ~130 lines

- [ ] 0.1 RED: `scripts/merge-engram-manifest.test.mjs` — unit tests: union, dedup by chunk.id, max version
- [ ] 0.2 RED: `scripts/memory/backends/engram.setup.test.mjs` — setup() tests: creates symlink, idempotent, warns on real dir
- [ ] 0.3 `git mv .engram .memory` — move 3 committed files; commit
- [ ] 0.4 `.gitignore`: add `.engram`, fix comment, fix stale adr-0003 ref → adr-0002
- [ ] 0.5 GREEN: harden `setup()` in `engram.mjs` — real-dir guard (warn + skip, no throw)
- [ ] 0.6 Confirm `.gitattributes` already correct post-migration (no edit)
- [ ] 0.7 Confirm pre-push hook already uses `-- .memory` (no edit)
- [ ] 0.8 `npm test` green
- [ ] 0.9 Manual gate: merge-driver round-trip on scratch branches before merging PR-S0

## Slice 1 — Generic Contract [REQ-S1-1, REQ-S1-2] ~110 lines

- [ ] 1.1 RED: `scripts/memory/lib/resume-schema.test.mjs` — validateResume(): passes with all fields, rejects each missing field, rejects non-array blockers
- [ ] 1.2 GREEN: `scripts/memory/lib/resume-schema.mjs` — REQUIRED_FIELDS + validateResume() pure fn
- [ ] 1.3 `brain/project/decisions/adr-0011-feature-scoped-working-memory.md` — author ADR-0011
- [ ] 1.4 `brain/project/methodology/feature-working-memory-contract.md` — resume.md schema doc + verb contract
- [ ] 1.5 `npm test` green

## Slice 2 — engram Backend Implementation [REQ-S2-1, REQ-S2-2, REQ-S1-2, REQ-E-1] ~290 lines

- [ ] 2.1 GATE: validate `engram sync --export` project-scoping (empirical round-trip); record CONFIRMED or NOT CONFIRMED
- [ ] 2.2 RED: `scripts/memory/lib/feature-resolution.test.mjs` — resolveFeature(): explicit arg, single dir, ambiguous, zero
- [ ] 2.3 RED: `scripts/memory/backends/engram.feature.test.mjs` — featureCheckpoint (writes resume.md, idempotent, no engram spawn); featureResume (engram save per file, no sync --export)
- [ ] 2.4 GREEN: `scripts/memory/lib/feature-resolution.mjs` — resolveFeature(root, explicitArg)
- [ ] 2.5 GREEN: add featureCheckpoint(feature) to `engram.mjs` — stamp, validate, best-effort enrich, writeFileSync; no child process
- [ ] 2.6 GREEN: add featureResume(feature) to `engram.mjs` — project files to engram (if 2.1 confirmed) or print-only fallback; print next_action + current_slice
- [ ] 2.7 Update `cli.mjs`: add ops to VALID_OPS, camelCase normalization, forward argv.slice(3)
- [ ] 2.8 Add feature:checkpoint + feature:resume to package.json scripts
- [ ] 2.9 `npm test` green
- [ ] 2.10 Smoke: manual feature-checkpoint + feature-resume
- [ ] 2.11 Epic invariant smoke: memory:share + assert no feature chunks in .memory/

## Slice 3 — UX: Auto-Resume [REQ-S3-1] ~100 lines

- [ ] 3.1 RED: `scripts/memory/lib/auto-resume.test.mjs` — tryFeatureResume(): exit 0 → stdout, exit non-zero → null, spawn error → null
- [ ] 3.2 GREEN: `scripts/memory/lib/auto-resume.mjs` — tryFeatureResume(root), never throws
- [ ] 3.3 Modify `ticket-start.mjs`: on both re-checkout paths, call tryFeatureResume; print if non-null; warn if null; never exit 1
- [ ] 3.4 `npm test` green

## Slice 4 — Checkpoint Automation [REQ-S4-1] ~90 lines

- [ ] 4.1 RED: `scripts/hooks/pre-push.test.mjs` — hook tests with synthetic PATH: checkpoint runs when change dir exists; exit 0 when none; failure is non-blocking
- [ ] 4.2 GREEN: update `scripts/hooks/pre-push` — after share, before .memory guard: `node cli.mjs feature-checkpoint >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` inside node guard
- [ ] 4.3 `npm test` green

## Closure Checklist

- [ ] C.1 `npm test` green on tracker branch
- [ ] C.2 Epic invariant: memory:share produces no feature chunks in .memory/
- [ ] C.3 Dead-ref sweep: no adr-0003 refs; no .engram in .gitattributes
- [ ] C.4 Pre-push guard live (blocks on uncommitted .memory/ diff)
- [ ] C.5 PR epic/working-memory → main; close epic issue

## Ambiguous Acceptances

- A1: featureResume() acceptance changes if 2.1 is NOT CONFIRMED (print-only, no projection test)
- A2: hook ambiguous-feature case (>1 dir, no arg) silently skips checkpoint; known gap
- A3: featureProject name format not pinned; decide at Slice 2 start
- A4: merge-driver round-trip gate (0.9) is manual, not in npm test
